NetHack 5.0 with a native macOS interface. Runs on macOS 12 or later, on Apple Silicon and Intel Macs.

## Install

1. Download the zip below and open it.
2. Drag **NetHack** into your Applications folder.
3. Open NetHack. macOS will say it can't check the app for malicious software, because this free, open-source build isn't notarized by Apple. Click **Done**.
4. Open **System Settings → Privacy & Security**, scroll down, and click **Open Anyway** next to the message about NetHack. Confirm with your password.

You only need to do this once. After that NetHack opens normally.
